Week 1 - Day 1.title: Warm-Up
Week 1 - Day 1.description: Start with 5 minutes of light cardio (e.g., brisk walk, easy jog, or rowing) followed by dynamic stretches: leg swings, arm circles, lunges, torso twists. Prepare especially for the movements to come.

Week 1 - Day 1.title: Barbell Back Squat
Week 1 - Day 1.description: Stand with bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width. Squat down to at least thigh-parallel, then drive through heels to stand. Keep core tight and chest up. (This is your heavy compound lift for legs – choose a weight that is challenging for ~8 reps with good form.)

Week 1 - Day 1.title: Bent-Over Barbell Row
Week 1 - Day 1.description: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, pull the barbell up to your lower chest, squeezing shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Week 1 - Day 1.title: Dumbbell Overhead Press
Week 1 - Day 1.description: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height, press them straight overhead, then lower to starting position.

Week 1 - Day 1.title: Leg Curl (Machine)
Week 1 - Day 1.description: Adjust the machine so the roller pad rests just above your ankles. Curl your legs, bringing heels toward your butt, squeezing your hamstrings, then slowly extend back out.

Week 1 - Day 1.title: Plank
Week 1 - Day 1.description: Get into a plank position (forearms on floor, body straight) and hold, keeping your abs and glutes tight.

Week 1 - Day 1.title: Cool-Down
Week 1 - Day 1.description: End with light cardio (e.g., slow walk or cycling) for 3–5 minutes, followed by static stretching: hold stretches for hamstrings, quads, glutes, chest, back, and shoulders for 20–30 seconds each.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Warm-Up
Week 1 - Day 2.description: Start with 5 minutes of light cardio (e.g., brisk walk, easy jog, or rowing) followed by dynamic stretches: leg swings, arm circles, lunges, torso twists. Prepare especially for the movements to come.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Barbell Bench Press
Week 1 - Day 2.description: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to mid-chest, then press up to arms’ length. Keep your shoulder blades pinched together on the bench and feet planted.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
Week 1 - Day 2.description: Hold dumbbells at your sides, step forward with one leg and lower until front thigh is parallel to floor, then push back to standing. Alternate legs.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
Week 1 - Day 2.description: Support one knee and hand on a bench, keep back flat, pull the dumbbell up toward your hip (elbow close to your side), then lower.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Cable Triceps Pushdown
Week 1 - Day 2.description: At a cable station, use a rope or straight bar attachment. Keeping elbows at your sides, extend your arms down to push the weight, contracting the triceps, then return to 90° at elbows.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
Week 1 - Day 2.description: Hold dumbbells with palms up, curl weights toward your shoulders without swinging, then lower.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Russian Twist
Week 1 - Day 2.description: Sit on the floor with knees bent, lean back slightly with a straight back. Hold a ball or clasp hands and rotate torso side to side, touching floor each side.

Week 1 - Day 2.title: Cool-Down
Week 1 - Day 2.description: End with light cardio (e.g., slow walk or cycling) for 3–5 minutes, followed by static stretching: hold stretches for hamstrings, quads, glutes, chest, back, and shoulders for 20–30 seconds each.

Week 12 - Day 1.description: End with light cardio (e.g., slow walk or cycling) for 3–5 minutes, followed by static stretching: hold stretches for hamstrings, quads, glutes, chest, back, and shoulders for 20–30 seconds each.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Warm-Up
Week 12 - Day 2.description: Start with 5 minutes of light cardio (e.g., brisk walk, easy jog, or rowing) followed by dynamic stretches: leg swings, arm circles, lunges, torso twists. Prepare especially for the movements to come.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Barbell Bench Press
Week 12 - Day 2.description: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to mid-chest, then press up to arms’ length. Keep your shoulder blades pinched together on the bench and feet planted.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
Week 12 - Day 2.description: Hold dumbbells at your sides, step forward with one leg and lower until front thigh is parallel to floor, then push back to standing. Alternate legs.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
Week 12 - Day 2.description: Support one knee and hand on a bench, keep back flat, pull the dumbbell up toward your hip (elbow close to your side), then lower.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Cable Triceps Pushdown
Week 12 - Day 2.description: At a cable station, use a rope or straight bar attachment. Keeping elbows at your sides, extend your arms down to push the weight, contracting the triceps, then return to 90° at elbows.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
Week 12 - Day 2.description: Hold dumbbells with palms up, curl weights toward your shoulders without swinging, then lower.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Russian Twist
Week 12 - Day 2.description: Sit on the floor with knees bent, lean back slightly with a straight back. Hold a ball or clasp hands and rotate torso side to side, touching floor each side.

Week 12 - Day 2.title: Cool-Down
Week 12 - Day 2.description: End with light cardio (e.g., slow walk or cycling) for 3–5 minutes, followed by static stretching: hold stretches for hamstrings, quads, glutes, chest, back, and shoulders for 20–30 seconds each.
